text: Appeal of Order to Comply (September 30, 2020) for 289 Rouge Highlands Drive.

The Property Standards Committee, Scarborough Panel: 1. Confirmed the Order to Comply (September 30, 2020) for 289 Rouge Highlands Drive, Folder No. 20 199557 PRS 00 IV, and in doing so grant an extension to April 30, 2021. 2. Directed that each party be responsible for a 50% cost sharing of the repair of the retaining wall only.
